search_console.decision: The report covered August 31 through September 27 and showed 972 impressions, one click, 0.1% CTR, and position 40.3. Its only meaningful position 4-20 page signal was the 510-thread battery page at 21 impressions, zero clicks, and position 7.7; the October 1 release already addressed it. Remaining position 4-20 page rows had only one to four impressions, and one Oklahoma query click was too weak or irrelevant, so no Data-led item was justified today.

authority.action: Published a CDC-, NHTSA-, and current WADA-grounded exercise and heat decision record; added a regulator-grounded menu-to-package verification checklist; added an image-free breeder-source CBD-hemp profile; connected all three through hubs and reciprocal contextual links; and logged the American College of Sports Medicine as a qualified factual-review opportunity. No outreach was sent.
